ndpaCompliance.description: Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 compliance — lawful basis, NITDA registration status, and DPIA completion

validation_message.missing: Missing field: ndpaCompliance — required for models that process Nigerian personal data
validation_message.recommendation: Provide NDPA 2023 compliance status: lawful basis under NDPA §25 (legitimate interests, consent, or contractual necessity), NITDA data controller registration status, and whether a Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) was completed under NDPA §32.

nfiuAmlCompliance.description: Nigeria Financial Intelligence Unit AML/CFT obligations for AI models deployed in Nigerian financial services

validation_message.missing: Missing field: nfiuAmlCompliance — required for AI models used in Nigerian financial services (CBN-licensed institutions)
validation_message.recommendation: Provide NFIU AML/CFT compliance status: whether the model has been assessed against NFIU Regulations 2022, CBN KYC framework compliance, and explainability requirements for automated credit and fraud decisions.

popiaCompliance.description: South Africa Protection of Personal Information Act 2013 compliance — information officer registration and Section 36 conditions

validation_message.missing: Missing field: popiaCompliance — required for models that process personal information of South African data subjects
validation_message.recommendation: Provide POPIA compliance status: information officer registration with the Information Regulator, the lawful grounds for processing under POPIA §11, and whether automated decision-making is used under POPIA §71.

kdpaCompliance.description: Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 compliance — data commissioner registration and DPIA status

validation_message.missing: Missing field: kdpaCompliance — required for models that process personal data of Kenyan data subjects
validation_message.recommendation: Provide KDPA 2019 compliance status: data controller or processor registration with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC), lawful basis for processing, and Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) status for high-risk processing.

gdpaCompliance.description: Ghana Data Protection Act 2012 (Act 843) compliance — Data Protection Commission registration

validation_message.missing: Missing field: gdpaCompliance — required for models that process personal data of Ghanaian data subjects
validation_message.recommendation: Provide Ghana DPA 2012 compliance status: registration with the Data Protection Commission (DPC) under DPA §17, lawful basis for processing, and whether automated decision-making is used.

regulatoryContactPoint.description: Contact point (DPO or compliance officer) for African regulatory queries and cross-border data transfer requests

validation_message.missing: Missing field: regulatoryContactPoint — Data Protection Officer or compliance contact for African regulatory queries
validation_message.recommendation: Provide the contact email or URL of the Data Protection Officer (DPO) or compliance officer responsible for African regulatory inquiries. Required under NDPA 2023 §31 (Nigeria), POPIA §55 (South Africa), and KDPA §24 (Kenya) for organizations that process personal data at scale.
